profile.headline: Software Engineer | OMSCS Graduate, Georgia Tech

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Assist Professors in the Computer Science II course (taught in C++) by:
Instructing weekly hands on lab sections for a group of undergraduate students.
Holding various office hour sessions during the week to help students with projects, exam material preparation, and general C++ questions.
Contributing to the creation of exams and projects.
Grading labs, exams, and projects throughout the duration of the course.

positions.title: Python Instructor
positions.description: Lead a class of 10 high school students from the Baltimore area who were seeking to pursue a college career in computer science. This program served as an additional educational environment encouraging the students to learn how to program and carving a pathway into the computer science world.

courses.name: Algorithms, Data Structures, Operating Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Architecture, Software Engineering, Database Management, Computer Security, Network and Cyber Defense
